description_for_human: Search transcribed painting lessons from mypaintingclub.com — colour mixing, edges, composition, value, brushwork, oils and acrylics. Every result links to the lesson page and the exact video moment.
description_for_model: Search the mypaintingclub.com lesson knowledge base with a natural-language question. Returns up to top_k ranked answers from real transcribed lesson content. Each result includes: answer text, lesson title, sales_page_url (mypaintingclub.com lesson page), start_time_seconds, end_time_seconds, and vimeo_deep_link (a https://vimeo.com/<id>#t=<N>s URL that seeks to the cited moment). Use this whenever a user asks a painting technique question about colour, edges, composition, value, brushwork, or oils/acrylics.
